observations: Close-up photo of a keyboard's control panel and partial keybed.
Brand name 'YAMAHA' is clearly printed on the panel.
A small LCD screen is visible but shows only a static icon (clef symbol), not a power-on test tone or display check.
Keys show mild yellowing/wear consistent with an older unit.
No power adapter, battery compartment, box, or full-body shot is visible.
Image has a 'MEGAPROJECTORS' watermark, indicating it was lifted from another listing (Jiji repost marker), not necessarily the seller's own photo of the actual unit in hand.

claims.evidence: Brand 'YAMAHA' is visible in photo 0, but the model number 'PSR 260' is not legibly readable on the panel in the photo provided; cannot confirm exact model from the image alone.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have dead keys/buttons.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, display lit, and keys/buttons being pressed with sound.

risks.risk: Exact model may differ from claimed PSR 260 (affects feature set and price tier).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number printed on the body (usually near the pitch bend wheel or rear label).
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified generic Yamaha keyboard, lowest tier for the claimed line

risks.risk: Missing power adapter could add cost for buyer.
risks.proof: Photo of the included power adapter or battery compartment.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/reposted image (watermark from another seller), not the actual item being sold.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the full keyboard taken by the current seller, ideally with a handwritten date or the seller's own background visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added uncertainty discount for possible misrepresentation

risks.risk: Physical condition of keys, speakers, and casing beyond the cropped view is unknown.
risks.proof: Full-body photo from multiple angles including rear and speaker grilles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, worst visible case

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, playing a demo song or showing all keys/buttons responsive.
Clear photo of the model number label on the body.
Full-body photos from front, back, and both sides, taken fresh (no watermark).
Photo of the power adapter/charger included, if any.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Yamaha electronic keyboard from the photo, but functionality, included accessories, and the exact model cannot be confirmed, so it must be priced at the worst-case (non-working, base model) until proof is supplied.
